docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $598.62 FILED BY BUSCH DON AS TO DEFENDANT CHAISON WILLIAM ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-15-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
